meta.title: REA reverse engineering
meta.description: Connects REA's MCP server so agents can inspect local binaries, Electron and JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies, Android packages, firmware, pages and captures, with evidence behind each conclusion. Adds the mcp__rea__* tools to every session. Requires REA installed globally first (npm install -g rea-agents). Analysis runs locally; native decompilation needs Hopper, Ghidra, IDA or Kuna. Turning the bundle off removes every REA tool.
